dataset: Philippine Standard Geographic Code — PH-ResQ offline identity reference
urban_rural: Intentionally null. The Q3 2026 PSA workbook updates urban/rural classifications from the 2024 Census; this identity bundle has not imported that column from the Q3 workbook.
notes: All 42,010 barangay identities and unique 10-digit PSGC codes are bundled across 12 CSV shards.
The source repository snapshot is Q2 2026. The only Q3 name correction published by PSA is applied explicitly.
The dataset is an offline identity/hierarchy reference, not a barangay polygon/boundary dataset.
PSA is the authoritative source. Tenasia/ph-psgc is a third-party PSA-derived distributor; PH-ResQ is not affiliated with PSA.
